root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `config->default_listener == config->listeners` immediately after the second `mosquitto__realloc(...)` returns in `config__add_listener()`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `config__add_listener()` grows `config->listeners` while a default listener already exists, `config->default_listener` must be rebound to the live first listener in the reallocated array before later `port` handling reuses it.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original leaves `config->default_listener` equal to the pre-growth listener-array address after `mosquitto__realloc()` may free and move `config->listeners`; the fixed original reaches the same protected `port` handling with `config->default_listener` rebound to the live first listener in the new array.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace records `listener_growth_rebind.default_listener_after_growth != listener_growth_rebind.listeners_base_after_growth` and still reaches `port_guard_sink`; the fixed assertion trace records equality at the same growth event while the protected sink event executes.

nodes.state: Immediately before `if(config->default_listener->port)`, the `port` branch still holds `config->default_listener` at a different address than the live first listener in `config->listeners`, so the next line dereferences a stale listener pointer and produces the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read.

Across the selected second `config__add_listener()` call, `mosquitto__realloc()` changes the base address of `config->listeners`, freeing the one-listener array that `config->default_listener` previously aliased.

edges.relation: The pre-growth `config->default_listener` alias captured before the second listener-array growth is the same pointer later reused by the `port` branch as `config->default_listener` at the sink.
